notes: 租户数据迁移白名单：只允许本文件列出的表/列进入迁移包；默认拒绝中心平台密钥类表与列。
内部 ID（id/tenant_id）、成员编号（member_no）、来源用户ID（source_user_id）必须原样保留，禁止重新编号。
示例租户 3（zuhu.alienyan.store）来自第二租户试点；新租户接入时追加/替换 allowed_tenants，并经 Lead 审核。

allowed_tenants.note: 第二租户样例；instance_id=0 表示以中心库 tenant_databases/tenant_instances 实际路由为准

forbidden_center_tables.platform_audit_logs: 平台审计日志（不随租户迁移）
forbidden_center_tables.tenant_databases: 数据库路由与凭据密文
forbidden_center_tables.provisioning_jobs: 开通任务流水（不随租户迁移）
forbidden_center_tables.server_nodes: 服务器节点与 SSH 凭据

roles.note: 租户角色，含系统角色标记

member_roles.note: member_id 为中心库成员ID，迁移时原样保留

tenant_settings.note: permission_version/timezone/订单同步与库存推送开关

store_credentials.note: 店铺令牌密文，按租户迁移到独立实例本地库

inventory_balances.note: 可随交易变化，做数量/末ID校验

stock_movements.note: 流水追加，只允许目标库增长

tenant_local_users.note: 已废弃：非认证来源的历史副本，不随迁移复制；认证以中心库账号/成员关系为准

relation_checks.name: memberships_without_tenant
relation_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {center_db}.tenant_memberships m LEFT JOIN {center_db}.tenants t ON t.id=m.tenant_id WHERE t.id IS NULL

relation_checks.name: memberships_without_user
relation_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {center_db}.tenant_memberships m LEFT JOIN {center_db}.users u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE u.id IS NULL

relation_checks.name: duplicate_member_no_in_tenant
relation_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT tenant_id, member_no FROM {center_db}.tenant_memberships WHERE tenant_id={tenant_id} AND member_no IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tenant_id, member_no HAVING COUNT(*)>1) x

relation_checks.name: member_roles_without_role
relation_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tenant_db}.member_roles mr LEFT JOIN {tenant_db}.roles r ON r.id=mr.role_id WHERE r.id IS NULL

relation_checks.name: order_items_without_order
relation_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tenant_db}.order_items i LEFT JOIN {tenant_db}.orders o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.id IS NULL

relation_checks.name: stock_effects_without_order
relation_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tenant_db}.order_stock_effects e LEFT JOIN {tenant_db}.orders o ON o.id=e.order_id WHERE o.id IS NULL

relation_checks.name: channel_links_without_listing
relation_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tenant_db}.channel_listing_links l LEFT JOIN {tenant_db}.channel_listings c ON c.id=l.listing_id WHERE c.id IS NULL
